faq_q_1: How can I place an order?
faq_a_1: Add books to your cart, review the order details, then continue to checkout.
faq_q_2: How can I track my orders?
faq_a_2: Open Profile, then My Orders. Live order data will appear after the API is connected.
faq_q_3: Can I change my delivery address?
faq_a_3: You can edit your address from the order details before submitting the order.
faq_q_4: How do I change my password?
faq_a_4: Open Profile, choose Change Password, and enter your current and new password.
